newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: PDVSA 1st half net profit rises to $2.12 bln.
newsitem.headline: PDVSA 1st half net profit rises to $2.12 bln.

text.p: Venezuelan state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) increased its net profits to $2.120 billion in the first half of 1996 from $974 million in the first half of last year, according to a company report obtained by Reuters from government sources.
The first-half profit compares to $2.129 billion profits in the second half of 1995, the report showed.
PDVSA made a net profit of $3.103 billion in 1995 and expects higher production levels and oil prices to boost profits to $4.4 billion in 1996.
The $2.12 billion first half profit was based on total revenues of $15.277 billion, up from $12.840 billion in the first half of 1995.
The state oil company paid $3.52 billion of its first half revenues in taxes and made investments of $1.184 billion, the document showed.
